name: @kinqs/brainrouter-agent-protocol
description: Typed agent event/command protocol for BrainRouter — the one vocabulary spoken by the CLI's headless mode and the Desktop app's agent host.

scripts.prepack: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');function w(d){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=d+'/'+e.name;if(e.isDirectory())w(p);else if(/\.test\./.test(e.name))fs.rmSync(p)}}w('dist')"

author: BrainRouter contributors
